title: Scarce World
description: World with rarer structures and fewer animals, encouraging exploration. Good for Large Biomes.
body:
- All structures (Villages, Ruines, etc.) are generated 2x as far apart. So the structures are 4 times rarer.
- Strongholds are 3x further from the center of the world.
- Canyons and big caves are 2 times rarer.
- Significantly fewer animals.

Especially good for Large Biomes.
